notes.title: Patch 5 - Content Wrap-up! 🐉🌒
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=h7Na58KZnTE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Hello, Tamers![/h2]

We’re thrilled (and a bit emotional) to bring you the last major content update before [b]Dragon Eclipse[/b] is fully ready [b]to leave Early Access in December this year.[/b] That doesn’t mean the game is finished yet—but more about it later.

We couldn’t have done all of this without your constant feedback and genuine support along the way. [b]Huge THANK YOU[/b] to each and every one of you for being a part of the Dragon Eclipse story. 
You all rock! ❤️

Now, without further ado, take a look at the content wrap-up for the game.

[h2]New Maps With Diverse Biomes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/285551ad2f517b4fb45cd8f35d6383258261e53d.gif[/img]

Each act of the game now features its own distinct biome: Forest, Desert, Snowland, Jungle, and a brand-new Shadow Realm map. Expect not only a stunning visual overhaul but also more strategic depth. The risk-reward ratio will be higher, with tougher enemies, but also richer rewards, and more decision-making opportunities to enhance the experience.

[h2]New Acts System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/e699926d1823bf140d7e6a3955f2395ed7e7627e.gif[/img]

Difficulty levels are being replaced by the system of acts, which makes the game more challenging and enhances it with extra story pieces. The fifth, final act, set entirely in the Shadow Realms, will provide the greatest challenge, even for the most experienced Tamers. It also features a unique economy system that will test your deck-building skills.

[h2]Formidable New Enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/d4c5587f775a1cd03cd9a7d848c4d9ac4f96f00b.gif[/img]

Prepare to encounter two new elite foes on your way. Those include:
[list]
[*] [b]Knight: [/b]An elite enemy with a defensive approach, focusing on dodging and shielding itself.
[*] [b]Spider: [/b]This creepy elite enemy applies weakness and stun effects. Beware: it weakens the last Mystling that attacks it at the start of its turn.
[/list]
To spice things up even more, there’s a new boss willing to give you a beating:
[list]
[*] [b]Uttur:[/b] The new acid-inflicting boss. Attack it, and Uttur will retaliate by poisoning your Mystlings with corrosive acid.
[/list]
[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Even though the content part of Dragon Eclipse is being wrapped up, over the next few weeks we’ll still be working on the game. However, our focus will shift to fine-tuning and technical updates such as the Switch port, localization, gamepad & Steam Deck controls refinement, various UX improvements, and bug fixes. As mentioned, we’re planning for the 1.0 release to go live somewhere in December this year.

Also, our dev team has another project on the horizon, so stay tuned for more info about that! Who knows, maybe the story of our Mystlings isn’t finished yet…

[h2]That’s it for now![/h2]

Feel free to hop in the game, try the new stuff out, and let us know what you think. And as always, we still invite you to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx]Discord server [/url]to have a chat, ask questions, or just hang around. Everyone is welcome.

[b]Until next time, Tamers![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626860/Dragon_Eclipse/

notes.title: Patch - Tech Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/6cddfe569f0a1c346d6233d0020a28b46f5b83a3.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626860/Dragon_Eclipse/

[h2]Welcome, Tamers![/h2]

We know you've gotten used to our bi-weekly updates, where we delivered cool new content for the game—whether it was new maps, new Mystlings, or new Tamers. We've always made sure to pleasantly surprise you during each update cycle. However, this time we had to pause the release of new content to improve what already exists. We’ve seen your comments and feedback (especially the critical ones), and we knew we had no choice but to sit down and focus on serious improvements to the game, both in terms of difficulty balance and the user interface. So today, we present a list of changes and fixes that we hope will significantly enhance your experience with Dragon Eclipse and make it even more enjoyable.

[h2]Enemy Rebalancing[/h2]

In this area, we've been working hard and it was our top priority. To fully experience the changes, we recommend starting from Eclipse 0, where the differences should be much more noticeable to you.

[h2]UX Improvements[/h2]

Work is still ongoing here, but we’ve already made many small and large changes, and there are still plenty more on the horizon. So rest assured—we haven’t said our final word yet, and many more changes are on the way.

[h2]Combat Phases[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/80c5ce8837a7d3cde615430b6aae17a92d3292f1.gif[/img]

We’ve decided to add a clear distinction between different phases of combat. This should clarify and organize the division of combat into its various stages. Let us know in the comments if you like this change!

[h2]Action Separation[/h2]

We’ve increased the gaps between actions performed by different creatures so that it’s clear who is currently acting and which effect is associated with each action. Actions are now arranged in a queue of sequential events, preventing them from blending together.

[h2]Target Selection Arrow[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/0736915b0ea97ce8fe3d95e6b9017d9b8803ee95.gif[/img]

We redesigned the look of the arrow that indicates which creature to assign a played card or consumable to. We think it looks much better now, but more importantly, it’s clearer.

[h2]Mystling Positioning Change[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/43337205d39d74629d57fb70718ac97364bf8e66.gif[/img]

Moving Mystlings could be somewhat unintuitive, so we’ve revamped the entire system. It is now much more convenient, simpler to use, and definitely faster!

[h2]Next Steps:[/h2]

As we mentioned, we’re not done yet. We’re currently planning to create a new tutorial that will introduce new players to the game’s mechanics even better. We’ll also continue improving the UX with further changes and work on rebalancing the gameplay.
Best regards, and we look forward to more of your valuable feedback on what we can improve or enhance in the game!

As always, thanks for being with us during the Early Access! We encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx]Discord server[/url] to hang around, ask questions, and give some feedback on the game.

[b]Until the next update! ❤[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626860/Dragon_Eclipse/

notes.title: Patch 4 - Fire and Earth! 🐉🌒
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/fb1825b95faf2d01cb17990e4227862f3a002058.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello, Tamers![/h2]
As usual, here we are, bringing you a pack of fresh additions to the game! 2 unique Mystlings will be waiting for you to tame them. We’re also introducing special Mystlings-related quests. By fulfilling those, you’ll be rewarded with an item of a new type - one of the powerful Mystling gifts. We’re also changing the layout of the Village (the main hub) to make it smoother to navigate and a better-looking one. Lastly, you can expect Tara, a new friendly NPC, to be your helping hand throughout the journey.

[h2]Watch the trailer to see what's new![/h2]
[previewyoutube=D5-jldquXTc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]2 new Mystlings[/h2]
Meet Gaiadon and Lear, new creatures that will aid you in your quest! Gaiadon, fueled by the powers of earth and nature, is a unique Mystling, only able to evolve during- and for the remainder of a particular battle. Lear, one born of fire, can turn his wounds into power, gaining strength equal to health lost when hurt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/bcc5558dfaa2ed4af376df6606e6096db5e6cd2f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/2ef93997ad3ecfe9e5ea5f3dec0ceb89d884a427.gif[/img]

[h2]Mystling Quests and Gifts [/h2]
From now on, you’ll start noticing Mystlings asking for your help while in the village. When talked to, they’ll express their needs and give you special Mystling-related Quests. Your aid won’t go unnoticed - Mystlings will reward you with their Gifts, acting as a new type of permanent upgrade to help you on the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/0a4eaf57a2228cf39e14529753aeea3a0ae09546.gif[/img]

[h2]Redesigned Village[/h2]
We changed the layout of the main hub, making it easier to explore and move around. The buildings are now further separated, finally giving their inhabitants some space to breathe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/c9f8104df1ccbdfff82365bc79063e318f6cb161.gif[/img]

[h2]Tara, a helping hand[/h2]
Say hello to Lyanne, your brand-new, personal guide, aiding you on your adventure! Lyanne will be providing her helping hand during the most crucial moments in the game. She’s not that much of an annoying backseater, we promise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/2d58eb0202409f2973aaed8cc34fc6879ffdbe11.gif[/img]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
Underneath the biggest changes, there are dozens of smaller ones, aimed at ironing out the game and improving the overall UX. Those include a few new story events, minor enemy balance changes, User Interface popups overhaul, improved saves during battles, and multiple bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/677c20b26befaec90b929243ffc2eb52b3123dd9.gif[/img]

[h2]That’s it![/h2]
Let us know which of those changes is your favorite! Try out the updated version of the game, while we’re working hard on the next content update, about to drop within the next 2 weeks.

As always, thanks for being with us during the Early Access! We encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx]Discord server[/url] to hang around, ask questions, and give some feedback on the game.

[b]Until the next update! ❤[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626860/Dragon_Eclipse/
–

As usual, a full changelog with each of the changes mentioned:
[h2][b]Changelog v0.25.0:[/b][/h2]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new Mystlings: Gaiadon and Lear. You can unlock them by reaching new Experience Levels.
[*] Added a new mechanic: Mystling Quests. Talk to your Mystlings in the Village and help them in need. This features additional unique battles and permanent upgrades (Gifts) for your starter Mystlings!
[*] Added 3 Mystling Quests for Iceling, Golomo, and Pinequeak.
[*] Added 3 Mystling Gifts for Iceling, Golomo, and Pinequeak. Receive them by completing corresponding Mystling Quests.
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved saving during Battles. Now returning to the Battle after using the Save & Exit button will resume the Battle from the exact situation when the player left it.
[*] The Village has been redesigned.
[*] Multiple popups and User Interface elements have been overhauled.
[*] Right Mouse Button no longer closes some popups.
[*] Rebalanced the Dogring and Siren enemies.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where ending the Round was causing a soft lock on rare occasions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Start of Battle trigger on Blessings and passive abilities wasn’t triggering properly in some cases.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3 - New Foes! 🐉🌒
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/8e8bb2db615fa2bf69d40cc8fac081466fec2866.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626860/Dragon_Eclipse/

[h2][b]Hello, Tamers![/b][/h2]

Another content update just went live! We delivered this one faster than usual, but it’s also smaller than the previous ones. The main highlight is that we added 5 new enemies for you to fight, as well as a new debuff effect. We also changed how the camera behaves during battles and implemented new card visuals to the upgraded Mystling cards. You can also now skip dialogues if you’re a fast reader!

[h2]Watch our official trailer for this update:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qvyvT6ycIE4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]And here are the details:[/b][/h2]

[h2]5 new enemies [/h2]
Give a warm welcome to [b]Darkeye, Blue Darkeye, Centervil, Siren, and Dogring[/b]. Not like they’re going to love you or anything, since your job will be to beat them down…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/238fe4649153d0c7bf9ac280012cb3e8ac0b69d6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/a6a7e0438a012b5a933cb7a474988acc35c65973.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/11cdaa45b08a7d1c43aa54d4c85e0b4803a5b0a7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/4698fe64a14fd69823ee37b350f11ae69bf1bddc.gif[/img]

[h2]New debuff: Acid[/h2]
Along with new foes, we’re also including a new debuff mechanic: Acid! It reduces power by 1 for every Acid counter, and at the stand of the round also deals 1 damage for every counter.

[h2]Reactive camera movement[/h2]
To spice the battles up a little, and make them feel more dynamic, we added a reactive camera movement! The screen will now behave adaptively to the actions you perform. Try it out for yourselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/33b0636a101bbbf3f5fa00a9c744492b4fe9a08f.gif[/img]

[h2]Dialogue fast-forward option[/h2]
This one is plain and simple - if you’re a fast reader, you’ll always be able to skip the dialogue and get back to the juicy gameplay!

[h2]New card visuals for upgraded Mystling cards[/h2]
We felt like the upgraded Mystling cards deserved to stand out from the crowd, so we shined them up a bit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/b2fc044bf0b533b806b0d000c747d57a4819904c.gif[/img]

[b]That’s a wrap![/b]

That’s not a lot of changes, but we hope those will make the game feel more polished and enjoyable!
As always, thanks for being with us during the Early Access! We encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx]Discord server[/url] to hang around, ask questions, and give some feedback on the game.
[b]Good luck and have fun playing! ❤[/b]

notes.title: Patch 2 - Dragons' Arrival! 🐉🌒
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/63deded6f14fe131d54a593e43d1f618018f3e88.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626860/Dragon_Eclipse/

[h2]Hello, Tamers![/h2]
We’re flying into August with another freshly baked content update. It's about time for some actual dragons to join our pack of Mystlings. What's more, we’re adding a Leaderboard, letting the most competitive of you flex your scores among the other Tamers worldwide. We’re also introducing new Enchant Arena mechanics and an overall game Compendium.
As always, thank you for participating in the Early Access process! Many of the changes were inspired by your comments and feedback, so we’d love for you to keep them coming.

[b]Watch our official trailer update for a visual overview of what’s been added to the game:[/b]

[previewyoutube=ZjiTTvPMpk8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]And here are the update details:[/b][/h2]

[h2]Two new Mystlings: Luminesca and Emberling[/h2]
Introducing to you: Luminesca and Emberling! These two beauties are fully-fledged dragons (kinda funny how we didn't have those yet). You can unlock them as you climb through the experience levels. Luminesca’s perks make her elusive, allowing her to dodge attacks after getting hurt too much. On the other hand, Emberling can break some rules and freely choose the opponent he wants to attack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/362f81afaeddcefa99042cb7a4654d02bbb1bc7a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/842ea0ba34f17ca6852f09d643376fe76f60efda.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/9be6c690917a7c0335249df6b63f5b3e3c115506.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/429c87aecdec7e15a97a4bdfbf8bfb10bda1da6d.gif[/img]

[h2]Enchant Arena Mechanic[/h2]
This mechanic includes 8 new enchantment cards that allow casting powerful effects on a particular slot in combat. For example, you can enchant your middle combat position with one of the cards, so it will keep adding 2 shields to any Mystling in this slot at the start of each round, until the end of battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/1174c01805e40a48244faa4f2ffc2d937a48430e.gif[/img]

[h2]Leaderboards[/h2]
After achieving victory on any difficulty level, you will face the Eclipse Crystal, a defenseless opponent designed for one purpose: to test your damage-dealing skills. You’ll have several rounds to inflict as much damage as possible. A global leaderboard will then upload your score, enabling you to compare your results with other players. Each difficulty level boasts its own separate leaderboard, to ensure the whole thing is fair. Go and give that Eclipse Crystal a good beating!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/d3b6c062716c12d64fb41700dbff8ed120ac048a.gif[/img]

[h2]Compendium[/h2]
Knowledge is power, and the new Compendium feature is here to arm you with all the information you need. Accessible from the pause screen, the Compendium lists all cards, blessings, and statuses, along with reminders of basic game mechanics. This should come in handy as a go-to guide for both veterans and newcomers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/f88dc5dede9a23c894f7ac31ab3434ae5f63085a.gif[/img]

[h2]That’s a wrap![/h2]
We hope those new changes will make the game an even more fun experience for all of you! Future content updates are in the works, with a new update planned for around 2 weeks from today.
Thanks for being with us during the production process. All comments, questions, and feedback are always welcome! The easiest way to get in touch with us is by joining our [url=https://discord.com/invite/X6WNQUUJnx][b]Discord server[/b][/url].
[b]Good luck and have fun playing! ❤[/b]
–
And for the most curious ones: a full changelog! New fixes and minor improvements are always on the go, so here’s a full breakdown of what’s changed since the last update:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626860/Dragon_Eclipse/

[h2][b]Changelog v0.23.0[/b][/h2]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new Mystlings: Emberling and Luminesca.
[*] Added a new mechanic: Enchant Arena. Positions on the arena can now be Enchanted with cards with a special keyword.
[*] Added 8 new cards with Enchant Position keyword.
[*] Added a new mechanic: Eclipse Crystal. After defeating the Boss players will be able to test the true power of their build by hitting a defenseless opponent. This features a global Leaderboard (separate for every difficulty level). Leaderboards may be wiped in the future around the full release of the game.

[h2]Changed[/h2]

[*] Improved targeting enemies when different sources (cards, blessings, abilities) were conflicting with each other.
[*] Improved clarity of Difficulty level selection buttons.
[*] Cards Compendium now displays Upgraded cards.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Life Absorber (Knock Out: Permanently increase Max Health by 2) Blessing was not providing a permanent bonus.
[*] Fixed a bug where Soul Twine Blessing (Any Creature faints: Activate twice) on Pinequeak was causing a soft lock.
[*] Fixed a bug where Eftus’ Activation ability was targeting already fainted enemies.
[*] Fixed a bug where played cards were moved to Draw Pile instead of Discard Pile in the first Round of the Battle.
[*] Added some missing tooltips.
[*] Added some missing icons for ongoing effects.
[*] Fixed some missing particle effects during Battle.
[*] Fixed environment sprite sorting issues on all maps.
[*] Improved visuals on triggering Blessing counters.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could start the game on Eclipse 3 Difficulty Level after resetting progress.
[*] Fixed a bug where Skitterpaw’s outline was not displayed correctly.
[*] Fixed some minor visual and spelling errors on some screens.
[*] Fixed overlapping interactions and dialogues in the Village.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player was drawing an incorrect number of cards when close to the max hand capacity.
[*] Fixed a bug where Mystling cards had different label colors on different screens.
[*] Fixed a bug where unlocked Blessings on Run Summary screen were not displayed correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where particle effects were not displayed on Consumables received from Treasure Chests.
[/list]

notes.title: 🐉DRAGON ECLIPSE DEVELOPMENT UPDATE! 🐉
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709668/4247001dba1ab5649f46dc492b046f6ab714dbc4.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626860/Dragon_Eclipse/

[h2]Hello there, fellow Tamers! 🐉[/h2]

It's been a while since our last update at the Steam Next Fest, but rest assured - the gears of development for Dragon Eclipse have been spinning at a dizzying pace! The Mystlings have grown stronger and fiercer, ready to help you dominate the battlegrounds. ⚔️

We're thrilled to announce that we're gearing up for a[b] launch towards the end of May or early June this year.[/b] It's just around the corner now, and we couldn't be more excited to share our development progress with you. So, without further to do, let's dive into what's been brewing in the Dragon Eclipse universe! 🎮

[b]Let’s start with a brief overview of the most crucial highlights.[/b] There’s a full-fledged hub up and running smoothly, accompanied by significant UI and gameplay flow enhancements. We’ve revamped how Blessings are allocated and how leveling works, making the experience more engaging and intuitive. What’s more, acquiring new Mystlings now involves thrilling egg hunts and challenge completions in order to hatch them. Additionally, we've introduced impactful consumable items, adding an extra strategic layer to combat encounters. All that to provide you with an even more dynamic and immersive adventure!

But that's just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to content updates. 

[h2][b]Dive deeper into the full changelog:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[b][*] Hub, along with a new progression system (egg hatching, unlocking new cards and blessings, choosing Mystlings, receiving a random consumable item before each run)
[*] Addition of consumables for use in combat
[*] Introduction of a special currency (for use in-hub only)
[*] Store overhaul, including the addition of re-roll and purchasable consumables
[*] Adjustments to Blessings allocation and leveling mechanics
[*] Changes to the Mystling Care Center to accommodate the new Blessings system
[*] Introduction of new one-time-use locations on the map (for healing and training)
[*] Lots of new content (cards, Blessings, various consumables)
[*] Expanded options for upgrading cards
[*] Improved responsiveness in combat gameplay
[*] A “Reset progress” option in the settings
[*] Enhanced localization
[*] Gamepad input support
[*] Code refactoring, numerous bug fixes[/b]
[/list]
